name: Vicissitude
source:
An interactive novel following the story of a young woman who finds freedom and happiness by dealing once and for all with her domineering and controlling mother. But death is not as final as it seems...
[From [url=https://nascantneptune.itch.io/vicissitude]itch.io[/url]]
